name: code-review-tool
description: Local, read-only code-review tool for GitHub branches and pull requests.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "tsx watch src/server.ts" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:assets && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm run docker:build
